request.title: Verify the parity-selected signed trajectory law and literal counterexamples (5000005)
request.body:
For Fuchs Conjecture 2.6 / AMR-049-0005, the unrestricted imported conjunction of the bare A0 endpoint-angle criterion and the signed type law is false for every n >= 5, as direct diagonals show. With the explicit segment-parity-selected K_PS convention, the signed law and first subsequent vertex existence hold for all n >= 3, all actually admissible transformed angles, and even shifts for even n. The counterexamples lie outside or on the boundary of the source's preceding open sectors; they do not refute that restricted source version. The convention is a supported completion, without a source-author-authenticated erratum or uniquely compelled raw-disjunction interpretation.

The accompanying research note is a credited verification and rederivation. Alper Ferudun's version 1.0 preprint, DOI 10.5281/zenodo.23267641, already contains the same nontrivial theorem, parity/diagonal qualification and existence, with substantially overlapping angular/reflection and direct-descent mechanisms. Classical double surfaces, cylinder shears, affine centrality and earlier pentagon descent are credited. Neither the theorem, type correction, trivial triangle case, full-affine formulation nor descent is advertised as new. GitHub PR creation on 1 October 2026 and the current related deposit's creation on 9 October 2026 are bounded chronology facts; they do not certify historical exact-byte visibility, relative discovery, awareness or independence.

The exact first-hit tracers and original controls corroborate the universal analytic proof. Ordinary/optimized checks and deliberately false guard controls are distinguished from proof of universality. All 16 original artifacts are preserved; the original effort remains 2/5. Extensive AI assistance was used for derivation, reconstruction, drafting, search and adversarial verification. This is an unrefereed preprint without conventional human peer review.

Published credited note: [10.5281/zenodo.23389367](https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.23389367). Successive NEW whole-package reviews completed; final clean. Actual tracker 'Math Puzzles'!A103:D103 verified by two fresh reads. Original-head MAIN merge follows separately. All16 original artifacts remain byte-exact in ORIGINAL_SUBMISSION; historical effort2/5 retained. The imported global bare-A0/signed-rule conjunction is false for every n>=5. The explicitly parity-selected K_PS signed law and first-vertex existence hold for all n>=3 with actual admissible angles and even ell for even n. Ferudun DOI10.5281/zenodo.23267641 already gives the exact theorem, convention repair and overlapping mechanisms; classical inputs are credited. No novelty, firstness, current openness, authenticated author erratum or independent-discovery certification. Extensive AI; unrefereed; no conventional human peer review.
